subject.title: vllm openai-completions streaming parser drops tool_calls when reasoning_content streams first for gpt-oss-120b at large systemPrompt

question: Should maintainers require an exact current-main vLLM gpt-oss SSE fixture before changing parser/recovery policy for this issue?
rationale: Current main appears to handle the reduced stream ordering, while the proposed fallback policies could change the boundary between assistant text and executable tool calls.

options.title: Require exact current-main fixture
options.body: Keep this issue open for a captured failing SSE stream or live reproduction before authorizing code changes.

options.title: Sponsor narrow generic regression
options.body: Ask an owner to add a synthetic reasoning_content-first native tool-call regression now and only patch if that fixture fails.

options.title: Close as unreproduced
options.body: Close this issue if maintainers accept source inspection of the reduced shape as enough and do not need the exact vLLM proof.

recommendation.title: Require exact current-main fixture
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for a captured failing SSE stream or live reproduction before authorizing code changes.

likelyOwner.reason: He has recent history on both OpenAI-compatible reasoning streams and vLLM payload behavior, making him the best available owner for the parser-versus-provider policy choice.
